comment: Packages that DECLARE an install script. Nothing here is ever executed: .npmrc sets ignore-scripts=true and CI uses npm ci --ignore-scripts. Each entry was reviewed; anything new fails npm run verify:no-install-scripts until reviewed and listed.

allowed.name: argon2
allowed.reason: install = node-gyp-build fallback; the package ships N-API prebuilds (glibc + musl + win32) that load at runtime without the script (smoke-tested by api unit tests).

allowed.name: prisma
allowed.reason: Prisma CLI preinstall/install hooks only print/verify; dev tooling. Engines are fetched lazily by the CLI on first use.

allowed.name: @prisma/engines
allowed.reason: postinstall downloads the schema engine; the Prisma CLI downloads it lazily on first use instead. Runtime uses the query compiler + pg driver adapter (no native query engine).

allowed.name: esbuild
allowed.reason: postinstall only validates the platform binary that npm installs via optionalDependencies; dev tooling (tsx).

allowed.name: fsevents
allowed.reason: macOS-only optional file watcher; never installed on Linux/Windows; dev tooling.
